name: inspect_apk_signature
title: Inspect Apk Signature
description: Inspect declared APK v1/v2/v3/v3.1 signers, certificate fingerprints, digests, SDK ranges, rotation lineage and source stamp without executing Android code. Returns exact file SHA-256; identities include scheme/source ordinal and certificates retain DER digests. Default summary retains complete Evidence; optional view selects signers/digests/lineage by IDs/schemes/fields and pages. Reuse inspect_analysis_view kind apk-signature after removing the source. Matching content digests do not verify signatures or authenticity; lineage trust and v1 entry coverage remain unverified. No device, network or SDK; malformed structures and resource refusals are explicit.

name: inspect_android_package
title: Inspect Android Package
description: Inspect APK package/SDK/permission declarations, decoded manifest, static components and class/resource counts without executing it or verifying signatures. Requires caller-supplied JADX MCP JAR and JDK. Default complete returns full Evidence; detail summary retains it and omits manifest text/raw duplicates. With summary, view kind android selects facet components (exact filters, fields, paging), component-summary or manifest (UTF-16 text pages); complete detail rejects view. Use normalized_result.parent_evidence_id with inspect_analysis_view for later views. Component source_index identifies the original declaration, and declaration_coverage preserves unknowns.

name: search_android_classes
title: Search Android Classes
description: Search complete top-level decompiler class-name rows in an explicit local APK by case-sensitive substring. Empty query inventories all rows. Repeated names remain repeated and appear in duplicate_names; the provider accepts only class names for lookup, so these rows do not identify which same-name class node a later lookup selects. Retains artifact and engine identity; no APK execution.

name: inspect_android_class
title: Inspect Android Class
description: Inspect one exact Android class's methods, fields, inner classes, DEX prototypes and encoded static final values without generating source. Select an overload_index from these results for inspect_android_method; indices are artifact/engine-session scoped and prototypes are not complete raw method IDs. Optional mapping_path adds verified R8/ProGuard names separately; observed names remain primary. detail summary retains complete Evidence and returns normalized symbols without duplicate raw calls; complete remains the default.

name: trace_android_references
title: Trace Android References
description: Trace incoming static using nodes to an exact Android class or selected method overload. A method target may be an external class directly named by DEX invokes: target_definition external and reference_scope direct_dex_invokes identify this narrower inventory, without inventing a class definition or body. Ambiguous external requests list observed DEX prototypes; select overload_index explicitly. For APK-defined targets use inspect_android_class. The total counts containing nodes, not individual invokes. External callers include source_selector for inspect_android_method. Source lines and the containing node dex_offset remain unknown. direct_invokes carries exact DEX code-unit offsets when available; direct_invokes_exhaustive false marks byte-bounded partial instruction evidence, and null means unknown. No reflection, JNI or runtime dispatch is inferred.

name: decode_android_resources
title: Decode Android Resources
description: Decode APK resources with apktool d --no-src: readable manifest, version/SDK facts, string resources/locales and decoded file count. Uses a temporary workspace removed after projection; smali/source recovery belongs to JADX. Strings default to 2000 valid entries per table; use string_offset/string_limit and table.page.next_offset for later pages, checking target.sha256 across calls. Per-call string budgets can be raised without restart. decode_timeout_ms controls decoding (default 600000 ms), independently of output capture and version probes.

include_strings.description: Project res/values/strings.xml entries using the selected string page and read budgets

string_offset.description: Zero-based offset into valid parsed strings in each selected table, default 0. Retry the same APK and locale with the returned page.next_offset to retrieve later strings; verify target.sha256 across calls.

string_limit.description: Maximum strings returned per selected table, default 2000. Applies on this decode; no restart. Independent of XML read and aggregate output budgets.

max_total_strings.description: Aggregate returned string copies, default 10000. The legacy multi-locale shape charges the primary strings twice; string_tables_only avoids that copy. Raise this or select fewer locales when exhausted.

max_string_table_bytes.description: UTF-8 source byte admission for each strings.xml, default 8388608. Raise this and, when necessary, max_total_string_table_bytes to retry an oversized table. Applies on the next decode; no restart.

max_total_string_table_bytes.description: Aggregate XML bytes read across distinct physical string tables, default 33554432. Raise this or select fewer locales. Does not raise per-table admission or string output budgets.

string_tables_only.description: Return selected strings only in string_tables, leaving top-level strings empty. Omit to preserve the primary strings field.

locale.description: Project strings from res/values-<locale>/strings.xml instead of the default table

locales.description: Project multiple localized string tables from res/values-<locale>/strings.xml alongside the default table (up to 20 locales per call; split larger selections into separate calls and verify target.sha256)

decode_timeout_ms.description: Decode wall-clock budget in milliseconds (default 600000), from apktool d start through process exit. Omitted means 600000. Applies on the next decode. Does not raise the fixed output capture allowance or the version probe.

strings.description: Primary string entries; empty when include_strings is false or string_tables_only is true. An unrequested field does not establish an empty table.

string_tables.description: Selected decoded table facts, included when locales is supplied, string_tables_only is true, or an explicit string page or budget is requested. Empty when included with include_strings false.

status.description: Table availability in the decoded workspace: present, missing at the selected path, oversized, malformed XML, or skipped due to limits

total_count.description: Total valid string entries before output limits, or null if the table was not examined or was malformed

unparsed_count.description: Entries skipped due to nested markup or missing attributes, or null if the table was not examined or was malformed

page.description: Selected valid-entry page, present for explicit string selection/budgets when the table was examined. next_offset is null at the end; otherwise retry that offset against the same APK digest and locale. If next_offset equals offset, raise max_total_strings or use string_tables_only before retrying. Table coverage still describes the entire table.
